purpose: Governed self-scoped create, revise and retire capability for Schedule Movement Policy with expected-state CAS and exact operation replay.

routine.return_type: TABLE(schedule_ref uuid, material_state_ref uuid, active boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Create/revise append immutable policy MaterialStates; retire preserves prior states.
state_history.current_binding: Create opens current history, revise performs exact expected-state CAS and switches currentness, retire closes the expected current episode.
state_history.chronology: Server mutation time establishes history episode boundaries; replay returns the original accepted effect.
state_history.immutability_policy: Existing policy MaterialStates are never rewritten; changed-intent operation-id reuse conflicts.

lifecycle.retention: Retain policy states, history and receipts for reconstructible governance and replay.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Retire closes policy currentness without destructive history deletion.

obligations: policy revision does not revise Schedule placement
